set.body: Implement a JVM Schaefer2018 volumetric loader using typed Schaefer2018 descriptors, CBIG volume and LUT assets, cache-backed loading, label/network/hemisphere parsing, provenance artifacts, and tests that can run without live network via local fixtures. Likely paths: modules/atlas/jvm/src/main/scala/scalafim/atlas/io/SchaeferLoader.scala, modules/atlas/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/atlas/io.
set.title: Schaefer2018 volumetric atlas loader
